d:
Jharkhand sthapna divas ke mauke par vidhayak jayram mahto ne rajy aandolankariyon ke samman aur unke yogdan ko lekar apni bat rakhi. unhonne kaha ki jharkhand aandolan men shibu soren ke sath-sath sabhi aandolankariyon ko uchit samman milna chahie. aakhir jayram mahto ne kya kaha? dekhie yah khas riporta.
